subject: Error rebuilding, restoring and downloading an archived shiny app

messages.author: cf527ce75619fbcf
messages.subject: Error rebuilding, restoring and downloading an archived shiny app
parts:
Hi, first of all I want to grats you because of the community, it's amazing the knowledge that has been collected here.
I'm quite a begin in R and shiny apps, I uploaded some early demos to shinyapps.io and everything was working good. Now, few months later the app I am interested on it's "archived" and I have the following issues. I have not found any tutorial that could help me, if they do exist of course please point me in the right direction.

* First of all, I would like to download the code I originally uploaded. When I download in the Bundle section in the dashboard I do get a gz file, but how can I get my ui.R and server.R files from there?  I just get a file with no extension.

* When I try to Restart the app I get the following error: 
Waiting for task: 108476214
  building: Processing bundle: 319564
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 313932
  error: Building package: BiocInstaller
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 108476215 failed: Error building image: Error fetching BiocInstaller (1.16.2) source. Error downloading package source. Please update your BioConductor packages to the latest version and try again: <BioconductorPackageSourc
* When I try to Restore the app I get the following error: 

Waiting for task: 108476438
  building: Processing bundle: 319566
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 313934
  error: Building package: BiocInstaller
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 108476439 failed: Error building image: Error fetching BiocInstaller (1.16.2) source. Error downloading package source. Please update your BioConductor packages to the latest version and try again: <BioconductorPackageSourc

Does anybody have any ideas? I'm quite interested in get my app up and running again, or at lesat get the server.R and ui.R back downloaded.

Thank you so much, these problems are driven me crazy and I'm sure other people with the same problem will find this useful too.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Error rebuilding, restoring and downloading an archived shiny app
parts:
Jose,

When you download an application bundle, it is a tar.gz file, so if you are on Windows I believe you can open the file with a tool like WinRAR. If you are on MacOSX or Unix, you can use tar. Besides that, it looks like there is something wrong with the application dependencies. Once you download the program, you can re-deploy it, which will hopefully resolve the issue.

-Andy

Thank you so much for your response. I will have to try redeploying.
About the downloading, it's strange but from Chrome in windows I was getting tar.gz file but checking with winrar, I saw a file with no format, and a lot of letters. Something was wrong. However, if I just try the download from unix verything was fine and I recovered the script. 

Thanks for your interest.
